JOYSTAR Onyx Electric Commuter Bike - Urban E-Bike
⚡ BUY AN E-BIKE & ENJOY SPECIAL HELMET PRICING! *Important: You must add the helmet to your cart for the discount to apply automatically.

Redefine your daily commute with the Hiland Onyx Electric Commuter Bike. Combining a sleek, "stealth" integrated battery design with a powerful 500W motor, this e-bike is the ultimate solution for urban professionals seeking speed, style, and efficiency.

Sleek urban performance: The Hiland Onyx with hidden battery technology.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Built for the city, the Onyx blends high-speed electric power with premium safety features to ensure a confident ride through any urban landscape."
Advanced Power & Control
The Onyx features a 500W brushless motor and a 36V 7.8Ah hidden battery, delivering speeds up to 20 MPH with a range of up to 40 miles. For maximum safety, the bike is equipped with dual mechanical disc brakes for reliable stopping power in all weather conditions and an integrated LED headlight for night-time visibility.

Precision stopping power with dual mechanical disc brakes.

Smart Commuter Features

Hidden Battery: Fully integrated 36V 7.8Ah Lithium-ion battery for a clean look and protection from the elements.

Intelligent LED Display: Easily track your speed, battery life, and pedal assist levels at a glance.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Get on the road faster. The Hiland Onyx arrives 85% pre-assembled. We provide all necessary tools and a comprehensive instruction manual to make your final setup quick and stress-free.

<

Watch: Set up your Hiland Onyx and start your commute in minutes.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

See It In Action

<

Experience the city like never before with effortless electric assist.

Our Guarantee
We stand behind the quality of our bikes. The Hiland Onyx is backed by a Lifetime Warranty on the frame and a 1-year warranty on the motor and battery. Experience a risk-free purchase with our dedicated 24/7 customer support.
